headline: Sensex Surpasses 81,000 and Nifty Reclaims 25,000 as Banking and Pharma Stocks Lead Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong performance in the banking and pharmaceutical sectors drove market gains
A correction in global oil prices provided a positive tailwind for Indian equities
Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 level after recovering from a dip in the previous Muhurat session
Late-session buying in PSU banks helped indices recover from early profit-taking
whatHappening: The Sensex closed above the 81,000 mark while the Nifty 50 settled above 25,000
RBI extended the supersession of Abhyudaya Bank's board for an additional year
BDR Pharma announced plans to acquire a stake in Acme's oral solid formulations business
Indian stock exchanges will be closed on November 10 in observance of Diwali Balipratipada
summary:
Indian markets ended higher on Monday, with the Sensex crossing 81,000 and Nifty reclaiming the 25,000 level.
Gains were driven by the banking and pharmaceutical sectors, despite early volatility and profit-taking.
Trading will be suspended on Tuesday, November 10, for the Diwali Balipratipada holiday.
